description: Department of Elections - Elected, Mr. Rambukana Vidanapathirana Sarath, Mr. Thuwan Aamith Mohomed Akram and Mr. Andara Costage Harisingha Harischandra De Costa from the Administrative District of Colombo and Mr. Asiri Rodrigo Bestiyan Koralage Randeer, Mr. Madampe Appuhamilage Manjula Prasanna Sampath and Mr. Ethiege Siridamal Felician De Silva From the Administrative District of Gampaha as the Members of the Western Province Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a Provincial Council due to members being elected to Parliament or resigning. It involves the electoral process for provincial councils, including nominations by political parties and declarations of elected members by the Commissioner of Elections. This falls under election-related matters as defined in Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
